blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About East Central Maple Ridge

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in East Central, Maple Ridge?

Active MLS® listings in East Central typically include walkable Town Centre apartment condos (52.7% of local stock), strata townhomes, and established single-family detached lots (median 6,459 sq ft lot size in Q3 2026) between 222 St and 232 St. In Q3 2026, East Central recorded Detached median $1,149,450 ($523/sq ft, 7,361 sq ft lot) · Townhome median $739,900 ($484/sq ft) · Condo median $507,000 ($631/sq ft). Every listing at the top of this page updates automatically from the Greater Vancouver Realtors (GVR) MLS® feed.
Which School District 42 schools serve East Central in Maple Ridge?

Public schools serving or located near East Central include Eric Langton Elementary (12138 Edge St, English and Early French Immersion K-7), Harry Hooge Elementary (12280 230 St), Golden Ears Elementary (23124 118 Ave), Maple Ridge Secondary (21911 122 Ave, French Immersion 8-12), and Thomas Haney Secondary (23000 116 Ave). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near East Central?

Residents of East Central enjoy access to Memorial Peace Park (11930 224 St), Maple Ridge Leisure Centre (11925 Haney Pl), THE ACT Arts Centre (11944 Haney Pl), Haney House Museum, and Port Haney Wharf. See our companion
East Central Neighbourhood Guide
for full park addresses, trail networks, and community recreation details.
How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in East Central?

Road and commuter links serving East Central are 224 Street, 232 Street, Abernethy Way and the Haney Bypass, along with Dewdney Trunk Road, then Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), plus Port Haney West Coast Express Station for commuter rail. They connect residents to the Golden Ears Bridge, as well as Dewdney Trunk Road, Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), West Coast Express commuter rail stations and TransLink RapidBus (R3).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in East Central?

East Central is governed by the Town Centre Area Plan (updated November 25, 2025), the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted January 27, 2026), and Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 within 800 m of Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station, alongside the Fraser River Escarpment policy area south of 124 Ave. You can inspect parcel-level setbacks, lot sizes, and suite permissions in our
Maple Ridge Zoning Guide
What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for East Central?

According to the 2021 Statistics Canada Census (custom GVR sub-area boundary compilation), East Central has a population of 21,150 across 9,150 occupied private dwellings, a median household income of $86,000, and an owner-occupancy rate of 69%.
